The '''Gharnus Texts''' were a set of ancient texts that were lost before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Jedi Consular]] [[Yuon Par]] recovered surviving Gharnus Texts during one of her numerous [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] expeditions.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Yuon Par}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Gharnus Texts were mentioned in the Codex entry for Yuon Par in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
